IGUI_Auto_quiver_tip: Unequipped arrows and knives will be automatically stored in the quiver.
IGUI_Point_Blank_tip: Shooting a zombie at very close range with a bow or crossbow increases the chance of an instant kill.
IGUI_Show_zombie_health_tip: Displays the zombie’s health after hitting it. Must be within range. Set to 0 to disable.
